# Storm Related Closure Updates


Share:


[Facebook](https://facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.1stsource.com%2Fnews%2F2026-08-12-reopening-updates%2F)[Twitter](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Storm%20Related%20Closure%20Updates&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.1stsource.com%2Fnews%2F2026-08-12-reopening-updates%2F)[Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.1stsource.com%2Fnews%2F2026-08-12-reopening-updates%2F)


Several 1st Source Banking Centers located in LaPorte, Porter, and St. Joseph Counties were affected by recent storms, and some locations were closed due to storm-related issues.


As of Monday, August 17, **all affected banking centers have reopened.**


**Questions?**


- Our Customer Service Team is available and can be reached by calling574-235-2000 or800-513-2360 , from 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM ET weekdays and 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM ET on Saturday.
- To find a nearby location, visit one of our other 78[banking center locations](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/) .
- As always, our[online and mobile banking](https://www.1stsource.com/login/) is available to clients 24/7.
